name: UpdateCase
label: Update Salesforce Case
description: Updates an existing Case record in Salesforce using the provided credentials and updated field values.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Case'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform on the resource. Must be 'Update'.

fields.name: CaseId
fields.label: Case ID
fields.description: The Salesforce Case ID (15 or 18 characters) of the record to update.

fields.name: Subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The updated subject of the Case (optional).

fields.name: Success
fields.label: Success
fields.description: Indicates whether the Case was updated successfully.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw response from Salesforce after the update operation.
